messages:
Samira (CS): Quick sync — Marlin private VPC cutover day 1. Customer reports occasional timeouts to internal object store during nightly backup window. They mentioned renewal sensitivity if not stable. Opening CS-9997.

Carlos N: I see short-lived 504s in ELB logs at ~02:05 UTC. Could be PMTU or a burst of KMS calls during rotation. Need their tunnel MTU and exact backup schedule.

Riya P: On KMS: their rotation scheduled 02:00 daily; backups start 02:03. That overlap can spike KMS API latency. Options: shift rotation, delay backups by 30m, or add decrypt caching for backup runner. Which would the customer prefer?

Marlin NetOps: We can delay backups by 30m if that helps. Our edge appliance currently runs tunnel MTU 1500; we can try MSS clamp to 1400 for a test window.

Carlos N: Please run this from a bastion during the next window and paste output:
```
curl -sS -w "%{time_total}s %{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null https://internal-store.marlin:443 --resolve internal-store.marlin:443:10.10.10.5
```
Also tcpdump: `sudo tcpdump -n -s 0 -c 100 port 443 and host 10.10.10.5`

Samira (CS): Actions: 1) @Carlos collect ELB/natgw graphs -> CS-9997; 2) @Riya propose KMS rotation + FAQ blurb and IAM snippet for cross-account audit forwarding; 3) @Marlin NetOps test MSS clamp and run commands. If variance >5% escalate to AM for renewal mitigation.

Riya P: Draft IAM note for audit-forwarding (short): `Allow arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/marlin-audit to GetObject on s3://marlin-audit-bucket` — will add KMS policy sample in ticket.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-9997 created  assignees: Carlos N, Riya P. Status: triage. Next update requested within 12h.

Marlin NetOps: MSS clamp applied for test window. We'll run the curl + tcpdump at 02:10 UTC and upload traces to CS-9997.

Samira (CS): Captured feedback: customer asked for a concise "pre-cutover network + KMS checklist" and a short FAQ on rotation/backups. Riya please add to onboarding repo backlog. Keep customer-facing updates in CS-9997 so AM has one timeline. Thanks.
